defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity for 8 seconds: use it to survive a hit that would kill you or to keep casting through unavoidable damage, remembering the 30 second Forbearance it leaves behind.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: 20% damage reduction on a 1 minute cooldown, so spend it freely on every telegraphed hit you take; it is usable while stunned.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Physical immunity for 10 seconds on yourself or an ally, best saved for a melee-damage mechanic; it causes Forbearance, so it locks out Divine Shield and Lay on Hands on that target.

defensives.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Cuts an ally's damage taken by 30% for 12 seconds at the cost of taking it yourself, so pair it with a tank hit or a soak and keep your own health topped while it runs.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency full heal for yourself or a dying ally; it applies Forbearance, so it cannot follow Divine Shield or Blessing of Protection on the same target.
